subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep-dive and trial preflight
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@healthsync.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep-dive and trial preflight

Hi Emma / Tom —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and a set of concrete next steps so we can lock the kickoff for the trial: 

Recap (high level)
- Primary objective: embed Redwood’s inference runtime into your internal triage workflow to reduce model latency and lower costs while keeping logs/audit within your VPC.
- Key constraints: data residency for PHI, SOC2 evidence required, expected peak throughput ~200rps for classification pipelines.
- Success criteria (we heard): 95th percentile latency < 200ms on standard prompts; inference cost under $X per 1k tokens; reproducible prompt-eval pass rate >= 85% for the top N intents.

Proposed next meeting (technical deep-dive + trial kickoff)
- Goal: demo integration patterns (SDK + on-prem connector), deep-dive architecture and config for latency/cost, align on trial charter & success metrics, and gather a prompt set for evals.
- Duration: 90 minutes recommended (we can compress to 60 if you prefer).

Can you confirm which of these slots works for your team (PT):
- Wed Jun 9 — 14:00–15:30 PT
- Thu Jun 10 — 11:00–12:30 PT

Prework items we’ll need (to make the kickoff productive)
- A short prompt sample set (5–10 representative prompts) — upload to the shared folder or paste in the email.
- Procurement contact to loop for contract/timeline visibility (if available).

Attachments included: neha_postcall_recap.pdf (summary), proposed_trial_timeline.xlsx (timeline draft), prompt_inventory_template.csv (template)

If those slots don’t work I can open a couple of others. Once you confirm a time I’ll send a calendar invite with a proposed agenda and prework checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Emma Li <emma.li@healthsync.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthsync.com>
Cc: HealthSync Procurement <procurement@healthsync.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep-dive and trial preflight

Thanks Neha — great summary. 

We’re available for the Wed slot (Jun 9, 14:00–15:30 PT) and that works best given our engineering calendar. I’ve looped procurement on this thread — they may join the kickoff for a quick 10–15 minute section on timelines/PO.

I’ll ask our ML lead (Tom) to pre-seed 5 example prompts from production and drop them into the shared Drive before EOD Tue Jun 8.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, HealthSync Procurement <procurement@healthsync.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Wed Jun 9 14:00 PT — agenda + prework

Perfect — Wed Jun 9 confirmed for 14:00–15:30 PT. I’ve sent the calendar invite. Proposed agenda (90 min):

- 0–15 min: Introductions and success criteria alignment (exec + product)
- 15–45 min: Product demo — integration paths (hosted API, dedicated, private) and latency knobs
- 45–75 min: Technical deep-dive — deployment architecture, batching/quantization options, observability and security controls (SOC2 evidence, audit logs)
- 75–90 min: Trial charter & next steps — timeline, roles, procurement touchpoints, and prompt/eval handoff

Prework ask (please before Tue EOD PT):
- Drop 5–10 sample prompts into the shared Drive or reply to this thread. We’ll use them to pre-seed the prompt inventory and build a quick eval.
- If procurement has timeline constraints, let us know early so we can align contractual milestones in the trial timeline.

I’ve attached a slightly updated proposed_trial_timeline.xlsx that includes two timeline options: compressed (4 weeks) and standard (8 weeks). I’ll also bring a draft mutual action plan to the call.

If you want the meeting shortened to 60 minutes, we can reduce the technical deep-dive section — let me know.

Best,
Neha

Attachments referenced: proposed_trial_timeline.xlsx, prompt_inventory_template.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Confirmed: Wed Jun 9 14:00 PT — agenda + prework

Thanks — I’m on the invite for Wed and have that slot blocked. A couple quick notes before the call: 

- Can we get HealthSync a temporary guest to our integration workspace (Slack channel + shared Drive folder) so engineering can exchange logs/config samples ahead of time? If so, I’ll share an upload checklist for the trial.
- I’ll pre-seed the prompt inventory with 5 canonical intents (classification + generation examples) so the evaluators have a baseline. Karthik — can you share the quantization/config matrix we usually use for 8GB GPUs? I’ll bring that to the deep-dive.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
